name: Wingman 2: Kitakura no Fukkatsu
original_name: ウイングマン2 - キータクラーの復活-
source:
The aim of the game is to find the killers sent from Podrimus dimension and neutralize them. The clues are to be found in the eight locations of the school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏目标是找出从波德利姆次元派来的杀手并将其消灭。线索藏在学校的八个地点。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
